name: inventory
label: Inventory Management
description: Full inventory lifecycle — products, suppliers, warehouses, stock levels, movements, purchasing, receiving, and stock counts

table_notes.inv_product_category: Hierarchical product taxonomy via self-referencing parent_id. gl_account_code links each category to a balance-sheet or P&L account for inventory valuation journal entries.
table_notes.inv_product: Master product/SKU record. is_serialized and is_lot_tracked drive validation on inv_stock_movement — serialised items require serial_number; lot-tracked items require lot_number. reorder_point and reorder_quantity feed replenishment automation.
table_notes.inv_supplier: Supplier master with commercial terms. payment_terms_days and lead_time_days default onto purchase orders. rating is updated by the application from GRN acceptance rates and on-time delivery KPIs.
table_notes.inv_warehouse: Physical or virtual storage facility. VIRTUAL type is used for in-transit and consignment stock tracking without a physical address.
table_notes.inv_location: Sub-location within a warehouse (aisle/rack/bin). location_type drives putaway and pick rules. capacity and capacity_uom enable space utilisation reporting.
table_notes.inv_stock_level: Aggregated quantity-on-hand per product per warehouse per location. quantity_available = quantity_on_hand - quantity_reserved. Updated by triggers or application logic on every inv_stock_movement insert. average_cost implements the weighted average cost method.
table_notes.inv_stock_movement: Immutable audit log of every inventory transaction. direction = 1 for inbound (RECEIPT, RETURN), -1 for outbound (ISSUE, WRITE_OFF). reference_type and reference_id link to the source document (PO, SO, count, or manual). All valuation history is reconstructable from this table.
table_notes.inv_purchase_order: Purchase order header. status transitions: DRAFT -> SENT -> CONFIRMED -> PARTIAL -> RECEIVED | CANCELLED. Totals are accumulated from inv_po_line rows.
table_notes.inv_po_line: One line per ordered product. quantity_outstanding = quantity_ordered - quantity_received. status transitions to CLOSED when quantity_outstanding reaches zero.
table_notes.inv_goods_receipt: GRN header recording the physical arrival of goods. May reference a PO (standard receipt) or be standalone (unplanned or return receipt). status = INSPECTING while QC is underway.
table_notes.inv_grn_line: Per-product acceptance line on a GRN. quantity_accepted drives the inv_stock_movement RECEIPT record; quantity_rejected triggers a RETURN movement or supplier claim. lot_number and expiry_date are captured here for lot-tracked products.
table_notes.inv_stock_count: Physical inventory count run. FULL counts all SKUs; CYCLE counts a rolling subset; SPOT counts specific locations or products. Variances are posted as COUNT_ADJUSTMENT movements after approval.
table_notes.inv_count_line: Expected vs counted quantity per SKU per location within a count run. variance = counted_quantity - expected_quantity. variance_value = variance * unit_cost for financial impact reporting.

short_description: Full inventory lifecycle — products, suppliers, warehouses, stock levels, movements, purchasing, receiving, and stock counts
long_description: Comprehensive Inventory Management schema covering procure-to-stock and stock-to-ship operations. inv_product_category provides a hierarchical taxonomy with GL account linkage. inv_product is the SKU master with support for serialised and lot-tracked items. inv_supplier captures commercial terms and performance ratings. inv_warehouse and inv_location model the physical storage hierarchy down to bin level. inv_stock_level maintains real-time aggregated balances with weighted average cost. inv_stock_movement is an immutable ledger of every quantity change, enabling full inventory audit trails and cost layer reconstruction. inv_purchase_order and inv_po_line manage the procurement process with line-level fulfilment tracking. inv_goods_receipt and inv_grn_line record physical receipts with QC inspection and lot capture. inv_stock_count and inv_count_line support full, cycle, and spot counts with variance calculation and approval-gated COUNT_ADJUSTMENT postings.
when_to_use: Use for any ERP, retail, manufacturing, or distribution platform that needs to track physical stock, manage replenishment, process purchase orders, receive goods, and reconcile inventory through periodic counts. Pairs naturally with the AP template for supplier invoice matching against GRNs and with the GL template for inventory valuation journal entries.
